content_body.title: Tell Someone What Helps
content_body.instruction: Tell one person one concrete thing that makes celiac easier for you.
content_body.safety_note: Support works better when people know what you actually need.
content_body.completion_message: You tried the skill. That counts. +15 XP
steps: Maybe a friend can help check restaurants.
Maybe you want people to ask instead of assuming what is safe.
Maybe you want someone not to make a big deal if you decide not to eat.
Choose something that would genuinely help you.
content_body.review_note: Review completed; publication approved by app owner on 2026-11-07.

content_body.title: Make Your Own Decision
content_body.instruction: Use the information available in one real situation and make the choice that feels appropriate to you.
content_body.safety_note: Every one of these can complete the challenge. Plan My C-Day never rewards eating an uncertain food or overriding discomfort.
content_body.completion_message: You tried the skill. That counts. +15 XP
steps: You might decide to eat.
You might ask another question.
You might choose something else.
You might use a backup or decide not to eat.
content_body.review_note: Review completed; publication approved by app owner on 2026-11-07.
content_body.clinical_safety_note: Do not frame eating as the brave/correct outcome. Do not diagnose anxiety or direct exposure. Preserve user autonomy and allow choosing not to eat as full completion.

content_body.title: Make a Low-Energy Plan
content_body.instruction: Choose one celiac situation this week and intentionally use the simplest workable strategy.
content_body.safety_note: Lower effort does not mean lower-quality self-management.
content_body.completion_message: You tried the skill. That counts. +15 XP
steps: Use a familiar food or place.
Repeat a plan that already works.
Use a backup instead of solving every uncertainty.
Ask someone else to help with part of the planning.

content_body.title: Stay Part of the Plan
content_body.instruction: Find one way to stay socially included even if the food part of an event does not work out the way you hoped.
content_body.safety_note: You do not need to eat at an event for the social experience to count.
content_body.completion_message: You tried the skill. That counts. +15 XP
steps: Join the activity even if you eat beforehand.
Use your backup and stay with the group.
Focus on the non-food part of the event.
Choose another strategy that keeps you connected.
